name: Soundgarden

whyMatters.en: Seattle band that kept 1970s hard-rock riff craft inside grunge; Badmotorfinger (1991) and Superunknown (1994) are the peak pair.
whyMatters.zh: 西雅图乐队：把 70 年代 hard-rock riff 工艺留在 grunge 里；Badmotorfinger（1991）与 Superunknown（1994）是巅峰双专。

note.zh: Superunknown 谣曲-riff 混合；MTV 饱和。

note.en: Drop-tuned riff + Cornell scream; Badmotorfinger face.
note.zh: 降调 riff + Cornell 尖叫；Badmotorfinger 脸。
奇数拍 + 街头打击客串。

interviewQuotes.text: We were a hard-rock band that happened to be from Seattle.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kim Thayil

lyricQuotes: Times are gone for honest men

body.en:
Formed 1984. Sub Pop then major. Badmotorfinger odd meters; Superunknown (1994) brings Black Hole Sun to MTV. Split 1997; reunite 2010–17.

Drop tunings + Cornell range = Zeppelin craft inside Seattle logo.
body.zh:
1984 年组建。Sub Pop 后转大厂。Badmotorfinger 奇数拍；Superunknown（1994）把 Black Hole Sun 送上 MTV。1997 解散；2010–17 重聚。

降调 + Cornell 音域 = 西雅图 logo 里的齐柏林工艺。

title.zh: Grunge 品牌里的 hard-rock 工艺

body.en:
Soundgarden keeps Sabbath/Zeppelin riff weight while Seattle peers push punk-slop or folk angst. Odd meters from Cameron; Thayil drop tunings.

Grunge chart act that still reads as metal-adjacent hard rock.
body.zh:
Soundgarden 保留 Sabbath/Zeppelin riff 重量，同时西雅图同辈推朋克脏或民谣焦虑。Cameron 奇数拍；Thayil 降调。

仍可读作金属相邻 hard rock 的 grunge 上榜乐队。

body.en:
Yamamoto early bass. Peak: Cornell / Thayil / Shepherd / Cameron on Badmotorfinger–Down on the Upside.

Peak flag on that four.
body.zh:
早期 Yamamoto 贝斯。巅峰：Badmotorfinger–Down on the Upside 上的 Cornell / Thayil / Shepherd / Cameron。

巅峰旗在那四人。

title.en: Four-octave scream, drop riffs, odd kit
title.zh: 四八度尖叫、降调 riff、奇数鼓

body.en:
Cornell: wide vibrato, high belt. Thayil: Guild/Gibson drop tunings, wah color. Shepherd: melodic distortion bass. Cameron: polyrhythm pocket (later Pearl Jam too).

Seats are specialist; songs still hook.
body.zh:
Cornell：宽颤音、高喊。Thayil：Guild/Gibson 降调、哇音色彩。Shepherd：旋律失真贝斯。Cameron：复合节奏律动（后也在 Pearl Jam）。

席位专家；歌仍有钩子。

body.en:
Chromatic riff, tempo gear-shift, Cornell shriek. Cash later covers it—proof of song under noise.

Pre-Superunknown face track.
body.zh:
半音 riff、速度换挡、Cornell 尖叫。Cash 后翻唱——证明噪音下仍有歌。

Superunknown 前的门面曲。

title.en: Black Hole Sun: MTV mass entry
title.zh: Black Hole Sun：MTV 大众入口

body.en:
Psychedelic chord color, whispered verse, big chorus. Video saturation makes Superunknown unavoidable.

Softest face of a heavy band.
body.zh:
迷幻和弦色彩、低语主歌、大副歌。影像饱和让 Superunknown 无法回避。

重金属乐队最软的脸。

body.en:
Beside Nirvana/Pearl Jam/AIC as Big Four. QOTSA and post-grunge hard rock cite Thayil tunings and Cornell range.

Grunge with metal homework done.
body.zh:
与 Nirvana/Pearl Jam/AIC 并列四大。QOTSA 与后 grunge hard rock 引用 Thayil 调弦与 Cornell 音域。

做完金属功课的 grunge。

note.zh: 巅峰录音与 MTV 时期。

note.en: MTV-era single that fixed Superunknown mass ID.
note.zh: 固定 Superunknown 大众 ID 的 MTV 单曲。

note.en: Drop-tuned hard-rock craft under grunge logo.
note.zh: Grunge logo 下的降调 hard-rock 工艺。
